tagline: 理光胶片相机，1991 年发布
description: 理光于1991年推出的胶片相机。配备Ricoh Zoom Lens 35-105mm, f3.5 - 7.5。快门速度Electronic shutter 1/4-1/500s with self-timer.。Phase difference detection autofocus system, with macro capability.。

specs.对焦: Phase difference detection autofocus system, with macro capability.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh Mirai Zoom 3 is an oddly-shaped autofocus 35mm film camera with a zoom lens, made by Ricoh from 1991.
